decisions: Headline: 'בכל מקרה הייתי עף בין הראשונים' rendered 'I'd Have Been One of the First Out Anyway', the way a Survivor contestant says it in English; the archive's APA gloss ('among the first eliminated') left as it was.
Subtitle: 'ארז את הקוביות' rendered 'packed up his six-pack'; the two Hebrew dashes around 'blame the heart condition' became parentheses.
'מאהבון צעיר' rendered 'a young lover' (the diminutive has no English form; 'boy toy' from the first draft read as a different joke).
'חתיך היסטרי' rendered 'ridiculously good-looking' rather than the calque 'hysterical hunk'.
'יש פה משהו' at the head of the prompt rendered 'They have a point.'

'איי דונט גיב א פאק' (transliterated English) rendered as plain 'I don't give a fuck'; 'לא לשים זין' as 'not giving a shit'; 'לא אשים על אף אחד' as 'don't give a damn'; 'חרא' / 'מניאק' as 'piece of shit' / 'asshole'.
'עושה ריסטארט' rendered 'reboots' in both the answer and the prompt.
'אסור לעצור באדום' kept literal: 'You can't stop at the red light'.
'עם ישראל בשבילי זה...' rendered 'For me, the people of Israel are the reactions I get...' to keep his phrase.
'ברח אפילו יותר מהר' in the subtitle rendered 'got out even faster'.
Agency names given their proper capitalization (Innovative Artists, Request Models).
lostInTranslation: The code-switch comedy of 'איי דונט גיב א פאק' and 'און אנד אוף' spelled out in Hebrew letters disappears once the words are simply English.
The diminutive in 'מאהבון' (little lover) has no English equivalent; 'a young lover' carries the Demi Moore joke without it.
'חי את חיי ה-VIP' loses the echo with the show title only slightly; 'the VIP life hasn't quite started' keeps most of it.

'After a session of hesitation on his side' replaced with 'After a round of cold feet on his side'.
'the man is a hysterical hunk' replaced with 'the man is ridiculously good-looking'.
'There's a sense that Lewis, only 24, has always been around' rebuilt as 'Lewis is only 24, but it feels like he has always been around'.
'leaning on his handsome looks and on the abs' rebuilt as 'on the strength of his looks and a set of abs'.

'They opened the pile-on on me', 'I won't account for what others think', 'In the frenzy of my life', 'something not good was happening', 'the body does a restart', 'Lewis is fairly tired' and 'the way the creators were compensated' style calques rebuilt as spoken English.
